questions.question: By what least number should 1200 be multiplied so that it becomes a perfect square?
questions.solution:
Given number = 1200

⇒ Prime factorization of 1200 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 5 × 5

⇒ Prime factorization of 1200 = 2⁴ × 5² × 3

Since, 3 has no pair, so it should be multiplied by 3 to get a perfect square

questions.question: 30% of a number exceeds 25% of the same number by 27. What is the value of the number?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Difference in percentage = 30% − 25% = 5%

This 5% gap represents the value 27.

If 5% = 27

Then 100% = (27 ÷ 5) × 100 = 540

**∴ The correct answer is 540.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: 30% of a number − 25% of the same number = 27

 
 
• 
 
• 
 25%
 30%
 0%
 100% (Number)
 

 Gap 5% = 27

⇒ Let the required number be x.

⇒ 30% of x − 25% of x = 27

⇒ (30/100) × x − (25/100) × x = 27

⇒ (5/100) × x = 27

⇒ x = (27 × 100) ÷ 5

⇒ x = 27 × 20

⇒ x = 540

**∴ The correct answer is 540.**

**__Additional Information__**

Percentage Base Rule

When comparing percentages of the same number, the percentages can be directly added or subtracted. For different bases, they must be calculated individually first.

Fraction Conversion

To speed up calculations, use fraction equivalents: 25% = 1/4, 50% = 1/2, 75% = 3/4, and 20% = 1/5.

Percentage Change Formula

Percentage Change = (Difference ÷ Original Value) × 100. This is essential for profit/loss and data interpretation questions.</p

questions.question: A, B and C can complete a work in 10, 12 and 15 days respectively. All three of them starts together but after 2 days A leaves the job and B left the job 3 days before the work was completed. C completed the remaining work alone. In how many days was the total work completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete the work = 10 days 

Time taken by B to complete the work = 12 days 

Time taken by C to complete the work = 15 days 

**Concept used:**

Total work = LCM 

Efficiency = (Total work)/(Total time)

**Calculations:**

Total work = LCM(10, 12, 15) = 60

Work done by A, B and C in 2 days = 15 × 2 = 30 units 

Remaining work = 60 – 30 = 30 units

According to the question, B left the job 3 days before the work was completed.

So, in the last 3 days, only C was working 

So, work done by C in 3 days = 4 × 3 = 12 units 

Remaining work = 30 – 12 = 18 units 

These 18 unit work is completed by B and C together

Total efficiency of B and C = 5 + 4 = 9

So, time taken by B and C to complete 18 units of work = 18/9 = 2 days

Total time to complete the work = 2 + 2 + 3 = 7 days

questions.question: 37 trees are planted in a straight line such that distance between any two consecutive trees is same. A car takes 20 seconds to reach the 13th tree. How much more time (in seconds) will it take to reach the last tree?
questions.solution:
Let the distance between 2 trees = a units

Then, the distance covered to reach 13th tree = 12a units

⇒ Time taken to cover a units = 20/12 = 1.67 sec

Remaining distance to be covered = 36a – 12a = 24a units

⇒ Time taken to cover 24a units = 24 × 1.67 = 40 sec

∴ the correct option is 2)

questions.question: PQRS is a square, M is the mid-point of PQ and N is a point on QR such that NR is two-third of QR. If the area of ΔMQN is 48cm², then what is the length (in cm) of PR?
questions.solution:
Let sides of square PQRS be a units

⇒ MQ = a/2 and QN = a/3

We know that, area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height

So, Ar(ΔMQN) = 1/2 × MQ × QN

⇒ Ar(ΔMQN) = 1/2 × a/2 × a/3

⇒ 48 = a²/12

⇒ a² = 576

⇒ a = 24 cm

Length of side = 24 cm

So, length of diagonal PR = a√2 = 24√2 cm

questions.question: If (3)/(5)P = (7)/(2)Q = (7)/(5)R, then what is the ratio of P, Q and R respectively?
questions.solution:
Given,

3P/5 = 7Q/2 = 7R/5

⇒ LCM of all the denominators = 2, 5 and 5

⇒ LCM of all the denominators = 10

This gives, 6P/10 = 35Q/10 = 14R/10

⇒ 6P = 35Q = 14R

Now, LCM of 6, 35 and 14 = 210

So, if 6P = 35Q = 14R = 210

⇒ P = 210/6 = 35

⇒ Q = 210/35 = 6

⇒ R = 210/14 = 15

∴ P : Q : R = 35 : 6 : 15

questions.question: A trader sells two items at the rate of Rs. 400 each. If he gains 15% on one and losses 15% on other, then what is the value (in Rs.) of loss?
questions.solution:
Selling price of 2 items = Rs. 400 each

⇒ Cost price of the item which amounts to loss = 400/[1 - (1/15)]

⇒ Cost price of the item which amounts to loss = Rs. 470.58

Here, loss = 470.58 – 400 = Rs. 70.58

⇒ Cost price of the item which amounts to profit = 400/[1 + (1/15)]

⇒ Cost price of the item which amounts to profit = 40000/115

⇒ Cost price of the item which amounts to profit = Rs. 347.83

Here, profit = 400 – 347.83 = Rs. 52.17

So, total loss = 70.58 – 52.17 = 18.41

questions.question: A solid sphere of diameter 7 cm is cut into two equal halves. What will be the increase (in cm²) in the total surface area?
questions.solution:
Given r = 7/2

⇒ Initial surface area = 4πr² = 4 π (3.5)²

⇒ Final surface area = 4πr² + 2 π r²

⇒ Final surface area = 6πr²

⇒ Increase in total surface area = 6πr² - 4πr² = 2πr²

⇒ Increase in total surface area = 2π(3.5)²

⇒ Increase in total surface area = 76.96 cm²

∴ the correct option is 1)
